children.name: select
children.description:
The fields to select. These fields are passed to
[Query](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/module-links/query), so you can
pass customer properties or any relation/link names, including custom links.

children.name: filter
children.description: The filters to select which customers to export.

children.name: q
children.description: Searches for customers by properties such as name and email using this search term.

children.name: id
children.description: The IDs to filter the customer by.

children.name: email
children.description: Filter by email.

children.name: groups
children.description: Filter by associated customer group.

children.name: default_billing_address_id
children.description: Filter by the associated default billing address's ID.

children.name: default_shipping_address_id
children.description: Filter by the associated default shipping address's ID.

children.name: company_name
children.description: Filter by company name.

children.name: first_name
children.description: Filter by first name.

children.name: last_name
children.description: Filter by last name.

children.name: has_account
children.description: Filter by whether the customer has an account.

children.name: created_by
children.description: Filter by the `created_by` attribute.

children.name: created_at
children.description: Filter by created date.

children.name: updated_at
children.description: Filter by updated date.

children.name: $and
children.description: An array of filters to apply on the entity, where each item in the array is joined with an "and" condition.

children.name: $or
children.description: An array of filters to apply on the entity, where each item in the array is joined with an "or" condition.

children.name: batch_size
children.description: The batch size to use when querying customers.

children.name: format
children.description:
The format of the exported file. Defaults to `json`, which is best suited
for GDPR subject-access requests as it captures nested, cross-module data
without loss. Use `csv` for a flattened, spreadsheet-friendly export.

children.name: to
children.description:
The user id or email to send the notification to. If not provided, the
notification will be sent to all admin users.
